rationale: Motor vehicle collision with vehicle totaled and policyholder injured; damage to policyholder's own vehicle caused by another vehicle in a rear-end collision.
claim_summary: Rear-end collision on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 am yesterday; policyholder's vehicle totaled (trunk crushed into back seat). Policyholder sustained whiplash and sprained wrist. Other driver's insurance information on police report; other vehicle traveling ~35 mph without braking at red light. Requires immediate vehicle valuation, medical follow-up, and third-party recovery coordination.

case_facts.incident_type: rear-end collision, other vehicle approximately 35 mph, no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: vehicle totaled, entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info on report
